name: Everforest Field
designIntent: Muted green field-note theme inspired by Everforest and Gruvbox.
visualIdentity: Muted green and warm earth contrast, field-note callouts, calm task lists.
cssEvidence: .document-reader .markdown-task { border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--reader-border) 55%, transparent); }
acceptanceCriteria: Light and dark modes are both present and independently tokenized.
Document width is not overridden by theme CSS.
File tree row height is controlled only through --reader-file-tree-row-height.
At least three non-color differentiators are visible in preview fixtures.
